node_greeting.speaker: Kote
node_greeting.text: The innkeeper looks up as you approach the bar, and for half a heartbeat it is like looking at a man through the wrong end of a spyglass — someone younger, standing a long way off. "Evening," he says. "We're quiet tonight."

choices.text: Quiet suits this place. Like the whole room is holding its breath.
A man polishing a clean counter has something on his mind.

node_quiet.speaker: Kote
node_quiet.text: "It does at that." He sets down the cloth. "Some silences are empty. This one's just... waiting its turn."

node_counter.speaker: Kote
node_counter.text: "Old habit," he says, and keeps polishing. "You can put a lot of things down on a counter. Some nights it's the only place they sit still."

node_story.speaker: Kote
node_story.text: He glances toward the road through the window, then back. "If you're waiting on a story, you'll want to start further out. Stories never begin where people think they do. His began with wagons, and music, and people he loved." A pause. "Begin there, if you like."
